title: Google Home Token Hub
status_ok: Master Token is active and ready for Home Assistant.
tip_account: Configured Google email address associated with your Google Home devices.
tip_session_status: Current authentication state of the Google Master Token (aas_et/...).
tip_ha_interaction: Time elapsed since Home Assistant last queried this Token Hub.
tip_health: Operational status of the Token Hub and local speaker communication.
tip_master_token: Permanent master token generated from Google OAuth exchange.
step1_desc: Enter your Google Account Email and Password (or 16-character App Password) below.
step2_desc: The Token Hub securely authenticates with Google and extracts your Master Token (aas_et/...) automatically in the background.
step3_desc: Home Assistant automatically connects with the Token Hub and imports all your Google Home speakers and devices.
token_label: Manual Web OAuth Token (oauth2_4/...) or Master Token (aas_et/...)
auth_success: Master Token successfully generated and saved!
modal_2fa_intro: Google strictly blocks standard password logins when 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) is enabled on your Google account. Please use one of the following two easy methods:
modal_2fa_opt1_desc: Generate a dedicated 16-character App Password for Home Assistant in your Google Security settings and paste it into the password field above.
modal_2fa_opt2_desc: Sign in at accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup, confirm 2FA/Passkey, press F12 (Cookies) and paste the oauth_token under 'Advanced: Manual Token Entry'.
modal_logout_body: Are you sure you want to remove the stored Google Master Token? Home Assistant will lose device access until you reconnect.
prompt_number_desc: Google sent a security prompt. Select and tap the matching number on your phone:
prompt_code_desc: Enter the 6-digit security code received via SMS or Authenticator App:
val_email_invalid: Please enter a valid Google email address (e.g. name@gmail.com).
val_password_missing: Please enter your Google password or App Password.
val_token_invalid: Invalid token format. The token must start with 'aas_et/' (Master Token) or 'oauth2_4/' (Web OAuth Token).
